location.site_note: Official state announcement and county minutes place the planned campus at 000/Ford Road in Gaffney; no public site-plan, building-permit, environmental, utility-service, CO, energization, or live-service record was located during the 2026-08-11 refresh.

status_as_of_cutoff: local process: Cherokee County approved the Project Kingfisher Fee in Lieu of Tax and Special Source Revenue Credit Agreement at third reading on 2025-06-23 and later ratified a related jointly owned industrial/business park ordinance for Project Kingfisher on 2026-01-05. State and county records identify Project Kingfisher as Cielo Digital Infrastructure's planned $2.1 billion, four-building data-center campus at Ford Road/000 Ford Road in Gaffney with initial operations expected in 2028. No public county/city site-plan, building, environmental, utility-service, construction-start, CO, energization, or live-service record was located.
evidence_grade: B: official state announcement plus official Cherokee County minutes confirm announcement, location, investment, facilities, expected jobs, FILOT approval, and industrial/business park ratification; MW capacity is corroborated only by trade/tracker sources and remains non-official.

status_history.status_as_of_cutoff: South Carolina officially announced site selection and planned four-facility campus. No county rezoning, site-plan, building, environmental, utility, construction, CO, or energization record was located.

The county minutes state Development Board Director Ken Moon announced Project Kingfisher is Cielo Digital Infrastructure, and Cielo SVP C.J. Maier said the project is a roughly $2.1 billion data center expected to create 30 jobs at Ford Road with initial operations expected in 2028.
